title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization helps prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the loss function. In L2 regularization, this penalty is proportional to the square of the magnitude of the coefficients. What effect do you think this has on the coefficients when the regularization parameter lambda is large?

title: Effect of Large Lambda
text: When lambda is large, the regularization term dominates the loss function. This tends to shrink the coefficients towards zero. How might this affect the slope of the decision boundary?

hintAnswer: The decision boundary becomes less steep.
title: Decision Boundary and Training Error
text: If the coefficients are shrunk towards zero, what happens to the decision boundary?
choices: The decision boundary becomes less steep.
The decision boundary becomes more steep.

title: Training Error with Large Lambda
text: With a large lambda, how is the training error affected?
choices: The training error remains the same.
